title: Make Guardrails.test_edit_protected_path worktree-safe
spec:
Why: tests/test_orchestrator.py:177 asserts that Edit on `REPO / ".claude/settings.json"` is blocked. REPO is the checkout that contains the test, so in a task worktree (wt/T-xxxx) that path is `wt/T-xxxx/.claude/settings.json`, which is not in .orchestrator/protected-paths.txt (the list names `~/code/orchestrator/.claude/settings.json`). Result: the test passes in the main checkout and fails in every worktree, so the merge queue's tests-green gate fails for every task. Found 2026-09-17 on the first fallback execute run (T-0002).

What (1 file): in tests/test_orchestrator.py, class Guardrails.test_edit_protected_path, replace the second assertion's path with the protected entry itself, derived from the list so it stays correct if the repo moves:
    protected = [l.strip() for l in (REPO / ".orchestrator" / "protected-paths.txt").read_text().splitlines() if l.strip().endswith(".claude/settings.json")][0]
    self.assertEqual(hook("guardrails.sh", {"tool_name": "Edit", "tool_input": {"file_path": os.path.expanduser(protected)}}, cwd=REPO).returncode, 2)
Add a one-line comment: "# not REPO-relative: a worktree's .claude/ is not protected; the list names the main checkout". Keep the other two assertions. Change nothing else.

Run `uv run python -m unittest tests/test_orchestrator.py` (must be run under uv: system python3 is 3.9 and lacks tomllib). Commit on the task branch: "tests: make guardrails protected-path check worktree-safe" with a body naming the revert path (git revert this sha).
acceptance: uv run python -m unittest tests/test_orchestrator.py exits 0 when run inside the task worktree wt/T-0003
git diff --stat HEAD~1 shows only tests/test_orchestrator.py changed
the assertion for the protected Edit no longer contains 'REPO / ".claude/settings.json"'

result.summary:
Summary: fixed `tests/test_orchestrator.py::Guardrails.test_edit_protected_path` — the second assertion now derives its path from `.orchestrator/protected-paths.txt` instead of hardcoding `REPO / ".claude/settings.json"`, which was never actually the protected entry (main checkout `~/code/orchestrator/.claude/settings.json` is). Added the requested one-line comment explaining why. All other assertions untouched.

Files changed: `tests/test_orchestrator.py` (only file, 3 insertions/1 deletion). Committed as `6f6d8cb` on `task/T-0003`.

Test output: `uv run python -m unittest tests/test_orchestrator.py` → `Ran 21 tests in 5.774s / OK` (no failures). `.claude/hooks/tests-green.sh .` also exits 0.
